_comment: Every RRset a nest's DNS record matrix publishes for its primary domain, by owner name RELATIVE to that domain ('@' = the domain itself; '*' stands for exactly one label: a DKIM selector, an ATProto handle) and record type.
'literal': true marks a name compared verbatim, its '*' the DNS wildcard label itself (the '*.<domain>' A/AAAA every subdomain site and plugin name resolves through), never 'any one label'.
'value_prefix' marks an RRset at a name the box shares with other records (the domain's own TXT also holds site-verification values and the like): only values with that prefix are the box's.

Read by tests/e2e-unified/helpers/staging_box.py (which RRsets a kept box at a zone apex owns). Pinned to the real matrix by the nest test dns_handlers::tests::box_dns_names_fixture_is_the_matrix, which fails when the matrix grows a name or type this file does not list.
Never NS, SOA or CAA: the box publishes none of them.
